key_insight: Lean can automatically construct a derivative, a correctness certificate, and a domain on which the derivative is guaranteed valid.
engineering_relevance: Certified differentiation can support scientific computing and machine learning workflows that require formally verified derivative calculations.
method: Reuse derivative theorems from Lean’s Mathlib library.
Use Lean metaprogramming to construct derivatives and correctness certificates step by step.
Index derivative theorems by the functions they differentiate to accelerate search.
evidence_signal: With theorem indexing, all 500 randomly generated test functions were differentiated, with a median time of 0.18 seconds per function—8.6× faster than without indexing.
watch_item: Success on randomly generated functions does not establish coverage or performance for large, real-world computational models.
